items.label: Office Storage Solution
items.value: Featuring with 3 fabric drawers, this file cabinet with shelves are designed to keep stationery, files and other home office supplies organized with ease. Proper size makes it a great option to fit under your desk or to have in small offices.

items.label: Multifunctional & Stylish
items.value: With a wide wood top and open storage shelves, this office cabinet can also be used as a printer stand, providing plenty of room for extra paper or files, or as a living room storage cabinet.

items.label: Ample Storage Space
items.value: Having 2 pencil drawers and 1 file drawer for A4 / letter size hanging file folders, the lateral filing cabinet can store large amounts of paperwork while taking up minimal space, and potentially increase productivity through reduced clutter and easy access.

items.label: Easy to Move
items.value: Rolling on 4 wheels, including 2 lockable casters, this mobile file cabinet can fix or move around your home office freely. Unique fabric drawer design makes it only weigh 22 lbs. and light to move.

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: Sturdy steel frame with wooden shelves and fabric drawer, provide strong support for storage while easy to assemble, spare time from putting together a lot of pieces.

items: This frame is made of FSC-Certified wood.

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: The product comes with instructions for assembly.
